tools.name: search-vacancies
tools.description: Search current vacancies in the Netherlands by job and place. Returns the total found and a list of vacancies, each with its key (for get-vacancy), employer slug (for get-employer) and URL.

tools.name: get-vacancy
tools.description: Get the full text of a current vacancy in markdown, with its salary, employer, place, URL and apply URL.

tools.name: get-salary-info
tools.description: Get the average salary range in euros per month for a job in the Netherlands, with its monthly trend over the last year and the salary page URL. Job titles are Dutch.

tools.name: get-job-description
tools.description: Get the job description of a job in the Netherlands: intro, what the job involves, tasks and requirements, with the job description page URL. Job titles are Dutch.

tools.name: get-employer
tools.description: Get the public profile of an employer in the Netherlands: name, place, description, website, number of open vacancies and the profile URL.
